The language of the return value. Valid values:

- zh: Chinese

- en: English

Default value: zh.

descriptions.zh: 域名找回时需要做txt记录验证，请配合<props="china">[生成txt记录](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145533.html)</props>  <props="intl">[生成txt记录](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/alibaba-cloud-dns/latest/generating-a-txt-record)</props>接口使用。

Use this operation in conjunction with the <props="china">[Generate a TXT record](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/145533.html)</props> <props="intl">[Generate a TXT record](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/alibaba-cloud-dns/latest/generating-a-txt-record)</props> operation.
